label: hAP
description: MikroTik hAP (RB951Ui-2nD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Inlet is eth1, outlet eth5. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap/ (read 2026-11-28): "The board accepts power from the power jack or the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE)", "The First Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet 10-28 V", "The power consumption under maximum load can reach 5 W", "The Ether5 port supports PoE output for powering other RouterBOARD devices ... supports up to 0.58 A". https://mikrotik.com/product/RB951Ui-2nD: Max power consumption 5 W, PoE in Passive PoE 10-28 V, PoE-out ports Ether5, PoE out Passive PoE, Low voltage PoE-Out current limit 500 mA, Max total out 500 mA. The inlet asks for 5 W; eth2-eth4 are poeIn: false; eth5 sources power it did not generate, so the budget is the supply, not a figure MikroTik prints.
